title: Theater manager Mr. Cummings and vaudeville pay
summary: Cummings called her to rehearse; pay was about eight dollars for two sets.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Do you remember Mr. Cummings that was with the theater there?
Mr. Cummings? Yeah I remember Mr. Cummings.
Yeah he was the manager. The manager of the theater there.
Was he the one that would call you before the, to come out?
Yeah he would always call to get someone to meet them you know. Then we'd go and then we'd get with the bunch and rehearse, have a rehearsing theater. Before they'd come on stage at night you know.
Do you remember what they would pay you for doing a show like that?

I think they paid around eight dollars or something like that. They paid around two sets or something like that, two sets they had at the vaudeville meeting. This would come out and then have another show and then that was it. It was around eight dollars. That was good.
Sure it was good. I was glad to get that. I was sure too.
